THE SESSION TRAVELS WITH THE CALL. `PlanActions.approve` gained `sessionId`; the scene fills it from its own live channel; the executor passes it as the tool's caller. The tool resolves its workspace AND session from that exec (`where(exec)`), so without it a surface cannot find the plan it is approving. Measured: A7 now reports `agentId: "fixture-captain-session"`.

the case's caller reader uses the PRODUCT's own precedence (`agent.session.id ?? agent.sessionId ?? agent.id`). Reading only `.id` reported 'no caller' about a call that carried the session — the observation disagreed with the product about what a caller IS.

`staged` IS DERIVED FROM `approvedAt`, NOT `phase` (`team-state.ts`). A fixture that set only the phase read as STAGED whatever it said, which is why the `non-staged-record` control could not produce the empty state it exists for. It now carries an approval instant when the phase is past staging.
